excluded_groups.G_ENTITY_TIMELINE: Uses the same birth/registration/ID-publish/gender/education signature tested in EXP07; excluded to avoid repeating the rejected hypothesis. Historical counts and next/previous application gaps also depend on a pooled train/test cohort.
excluded_groups.UIDY_SUPERVISED_MEMORY: Uses labels joined on the same signature with a global seed-42 five-fold assignment, which is not nested inside EXP08 outer folds. Excluded because that construction leaks outer-validation labels.

model_configurations.combined_candidate: Phase 2 LightGBM CPU + CatBoost GPU; CUDA XGBoost added only when an explicit CUDA preflight succeeds
model_configurations.individual_family_screen: LightGBM CPU; Phase 2 inner settings capped at 600 rounds and 50-round early stopping; outer rounds fixed by inner validation
